decisions.statement: A carried row keeps the old row whole as what the mechanic was handed.
The mechanic a row names is read from the fields that row already has.
A row holding a mode is a strike, and one holding a difficulty is a check.
A row spending an attribute point is the levelling the game already has.
Each carried row follows the row before it by that row's hash.
Nothing is worked out again, so no carried row gains an answer it never had.

definition: rows of an older roll log carried into the log of mechanics a game has run
